scripts.build: node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w front-end build && node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w back-end build && node scripts/write-release-metadata.mjs
scripts.build:netlify: node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w front-end build && node scripts/write-release-metadata.mjs && node scripts/write-netlify-headers.mjs
scripts.lint-server: node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w back-end lint-fix && node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w back-end server
scripts.lint-serve: node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w front-end lint-fix && node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w front-end serve
scripts.lint: node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run lint:root && node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w front-end lint && node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w back-end lint
scripts.lint-fix: node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w front-end lint-fix && node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w back-end lint-fix
scripts.test: node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w front-end test && node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w back-end test
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w front-end typecheck && node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w back-end typecheck
scripts.up: taze major -I && node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w front-end up && node scripts/run-pinned-npm.mjs run -w back-end up

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: test -x ./node_modules/.bin/lint-staged || { echo 'lint-staged is not installed. Run npm install.'; exit 1; }; ./node_modules/.bin/lint-staged
